Keep passenger travel outside two return-home exceptions: Tunisians returning to Tunisia and Libyans leaving Tunisia for Libya. Goods status is not separately established. P1 retains 10 August start/end calendar dates, reported 14:00–22:00 clocks, same-day treatment and zero complete/exact-duration flags. No measured elapsed-time or greater-than-24-hour claim is made. Retain Uncoded. Neither the nationality exceptions nor general Libya–Tunisia context supply an official rationale absent from the report. A new indexed retrieval reproduces the correspondent’s substantive account after another direct timeout. Full-text access is not claimed. The incidental Tunisie Numerique search result cites a private radio and is not used as independent corroboration. The named crossing remains unlocated; a place name and nationality-direction description do not supply an approved geometry binding.
